stage_1_inputs.batting_first: First innings team from the recorded innings order
stage_1_inputs.starter: Eleven listed players after excluding recorded incoming match replacements; blank when the starting XI cannot be established

limitations: Completed standard IPL T20 matches only; DLS, no-result and super-over matches excluded.
Player runs are per listed appearance, including did-not-bat zeroes; not conditional on batting position.
Boundary threat is expected fraction of non-wide deliveries producing a batter four/six against a bowler; no-balls count, non-boundary overthrows do not.
Chasing totals are truncated by reaching the target. Pre-match squad strength uses the last completed starting XI.
Home advantage is inferred from earlier IPL seasons. Ground history describes completed matches; pitch conditions and weather are unmeasured.
